statements.text: Qwen2.5-32B decision sharing on full-population Settlements: every changed judgment turns a non-match into a match
Qwen2.5-32B decision sharing: nine of the links that join separate components are incorrect
Each incorrect joining link adds too few true relations to satisfy the cluster-F1 improvement condition
Under connected components the changed judgments cause nine component merges
The largest merge joins four components
The largest merge spans five reference entities
The second judgment collection changes ten judgments
Nine of the 16 Settlements configurations are negative (connected components minus center)
